recon.numAcceptedGtOneHow:
num_accepted>1 is the LATER (multi-token-accept) verify forwards, NOT the first. greedy cat9 on the SWE prompts accepts multiple tokens at many events (accept/event ~3.18 on the locked cat9 path). The prior-window spans prior + newly-accepted tokens only when accepted_len>1.

WIRING that exposes it: at num_accepted>1, gather_committed_path_conv_prior reads read_node_col = accepted_paths[b, accepted_len-1] (a DEEP node, e.g. node 4/leaf for a 5-deep accept), so the prior window is that committed leaf node's banked window (last width-1=3 taps of prior ++ committed-path tokens). At num_accepted==1 the read is node 0 / root (trivial prior window) -- the bug does NOT manifest there (that is the negative control: conv SHOULD match at num_accepted==1; if it diverges even there the seam is broader).

HOW to land the capture on a num_accepted>1 forward: the capture selector is FR12_SUBKERNEL_CAPTURE_SKIP=<N> (skips the first N candidate captures) + FR12_SUBKERNEL_CAPTURE_LIMIT=1 + FR12_SUBKERNEL_CAPTURE_LAYER_PREFIX=language_model.model.layers.0.linear_attn (the L0 GDN layer, where the original 18.375 was). The reference reproduction in FR13_CONV_PRIOR_SLOT_FIX_BIND hit it at call2 (capture_saved_index 2, i.e. SKIP=2). Note: the FR12_SUBKERNEL_CAPTURE_NUM_TOKENS filter keys on num_actual_tokens (forward token count), NOT directly num_accepted -- it is a coarse filter; use SKIP to step to a later forward and READ BACK the captured tree_conv_detail.metadata_num_accepted_tokens / accepted_lens (and native_conv_detail.metadata_num_accepted_tokens) to CONFIRM accepted_len>1 for the target request BEFORE trusting the RAW max_abs. The bind run's call2 had the deep accept (tree read col [[4]] = a depth-4 leaf, accepted_len=5). The capture MUST be EAGER (ENFORCE_EAGER=1): the conv1d_out capture and conv-detail meta are skipped inside CUDA stream capture (_fr12_subkernel_capture_get returns None when is_current_stream_capturing).
recon.comparisonRows:
The comparison is RAW max_abs |our_conv1d_out - native_conv1d_out| at the COMMITTED-PATH rows of the multi-accept event, computed offline from the two captures.

OUR side (tree arm): conv1d_out capture = mixed_qkv_spec post tree-conv emulation (scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:3063-3068), tensor [num_spec_decodes*tree_n, head_dim]. The committed path0 spine rows are selected by tree_conv_detail.path0_nodes (and native_chain_source_indices_path0 maps node->native-chain position). For the FIRST-divergence row that previously failed: path0 ROW 0 (the depth-0 committed token, the row that read the 3-tap prior window cols [0,1,2]) -- this is the row that staircased to 18.375 (depth-0, 3 history taps differ) and is now 0.0. Deeper path0 rows (depth 1-4) read fewer/no history taps so they were already 0.0 (staircase: depth3 = 0 taps = 0.0).

NATIVE side: native arm conv1d_out [path0_len, head_dim] (the native causal_conv1d_update chain over the committed spine), OR native_conv_detail.window/prior_window for a per-row reconstruction. Align rows via native_chain_source_indices_path0 (tree_conv_detail) and source_indices (native_conv_detail).

THE BINDING ROWS: row0 of path0 at L0 (language_model.model.layers.0.linear_attn) at the call where accepted_len>1. The bind doc reports this as conv1d_out RAW max_abs = 0.0 (row0), down from 18.375036. Negative control row: any num_accepted==1 forward -> expect 0.0 (trivial prior window). Multi-row cross-check: prior_window_max_abs (0.0) and window_row0_max_abs (0.0) from the conv-detail join.

CRITICAL CAVEAT for any fresh boot: read prior_window_source on the native_conv_detail. If it is "post_update_fallback" (not "pre_update"), the native ref is POISONED (the 2fc0fb46 confound, spurious 1-col shift) and any nonzero RAW is INVALID -- re-capture with FR12_TREE_CONV_STATE_FULL_CAPTURE=1 to force the clean prior_full_row_pre_update reference. Do NOT fit the read convention to a post_update ref (that is the documented metric-hack).

RESULT: conv prior-window seam is CLOSED on HEAD 62cf3c0b, RAW max_abs gate PASSES at num_accepted>1. Booted the locked cat9 tree server (eager, TREE_ATTN, FR13_TREE_CONV_FUSED engaged) and a paired native MTP-5 arm (FLASH_ATTN, genuine causal_conv1d_update, clean pre_update ref), drove greedy SWE prompts, captured 30 L0 GDN verify forwards (23 with num_accepted>1, 6 neg-control at num_accepted==1).

Conv is RULED OUT as the 22-flip carrier; the live carrier per recent commits is diffuse L0-L58 GDN accumulation / TREE_ATTN+fp8 over the deep spine, consistent with the prompt RECON.
